prompts.building-growth-atlas:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for Beargame, a cozy mobile forest-bear town game. Generate exactly ONE new transparent sprite atlas containing exactly TWELVE distinct isolated buildings, in a STRICT grid of FOUR equal-width columns by THREE equal-height rows. Landscape canvas, ideally 1536 by 1152. Each building centered in its own equal cell, entirely inside the middle 80% of that cell. Leave very generous completely transparent gutters between cells and an outer transparent margin. Do not draw the grid. No labels, no people, no bears, no floor/ground panels, no scenery, no background.
Style: flat hand-drawn children's storybook game art. Thick slightly irregular dark charcoal-brown outlines, soft cream walls, muted sage green roofs, honey yellow details, warm timber brown. Very simple legible silhouettes, barely any shading, minimal paper-like texture, no 3D rendering, no photorealism. Match a cozy existing asset family of cream cottages with olive-sage roofs, round wooden doors, simple dark outlines, little rounded shrubs joined to the building. Whole building visible, readable at small icon size. Mostly front view with a very slight three-quarter angle, consistent across atlas.
EXACT cell contents reading left to right:
Row 1 column 1: expanded apiary consisting of THREE yellow tiered beehives, one large center hive and two smaller side hives, connected by a small timber hive stand.
Row 1 column 2: expanded tree-trunk bear hut, main large hollow timber trunk home with a cream round window and sage roof, attached smaller side room clearly visible.
Row 1 column 3: cozy solid timber loghouse with sage gabled roof, round door, two windows, stacked-log wall ends.
Row 1 column 4: large TWO-STORY woodland manor, cream and timber façade, wide sage gabled roof, two clear stories of windows, slightly grander than loghouse.
Row 2 column 1: expanded woodland library with obvious OPEN BOOK emblem above door and a small attached tower.
Row 2 column 2: academy with a cream-and-sage observatory DOME and a small attached telescope.
Row 2 column 3: organized lumber yard, small timber shelter plus neatly stacked cut logs and a visible large simple saw.
Row 2 column 4: large barn with sage roof and double doors, TWO attached cylindrical granaries or grain silos.
Row 3 column 1: wind-up timber workshop, simple timber house with one prominent cogwheel and a wind-up mechanism wheel.
Row 3 column 2: brick smelter, brick furnace body with a dark arch opening and tiny honey-yellow fire, a tall chimney attached, no floating smoke.
Row 3 column 3: small modern forest factory, cream façade and sage roof, TWO chimneys and one visible gear detail, no floating smoke.
Row 3 column 4: rocket launch platform with one small cream and honey-yellow capsule rocket, simple timber/metal gantry, compact base.
All twelve must be separate complete sprites. Actual alpha transparency. No detached decorative particles, sparkles, lettering, numbering, borders, watermarks, shadows on an invisible ground, checkerboard pattern or black background.
prompts.worker-roles-atlas:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production character animation pose sprite atlas for Beargame, a cozy mobile forest-bear town game. Generate exactly ONE new transparent sprite atlas containing exactly TWELVE isolated whole-body poses of the SAME bear, in a STRICT grid of FOUR equal-width columns by THREE equal-height rows. Landscape canvas, ideally 1536 by 1152. Equal cells, each pose centered in middle 80% of its cell, same character size in every cell, whole body and held tool entirely visible, generous completely transparent gutters and outer transparent margin. No grid lines, no labels, no scenery, no ground, no background.
Character design: extremely simple pudgy teddy bear, warm cream-white filled body, big round head merging into pear-shaped round belly, small rounded ears, short stubby arms and legs, tiny round black dot eyes, small black oval nose, tiny W-shaped smiling mouth. No clothing. Thick slightly irregular dark charcoal outlines. Consistent head and body proportions across all twelve poses, like a simple hand-drawn children's storybook mascot. Flat cream coloring, almost no shading, no fur texture, no 3D, no photorealism. Props muted honey-yellow, sage-green, warm timber brown, dull gray. Still readable at tiny game-sprite size. Feet/hips align consistently for related poses, do not vary camera scale.
Exact ordered cell contents, left to right:
Row 1 column 1: bear carrying a single cut log horizontally in front, body and face pointing RIGHT, walking stance.
Row 1 column 2: same bear lifting that single cut log upward, body and face pointing RIGHT, arms raised a little.
Row 1 column 3: same bear walking empty-handed RIGHT, one foot forward and arms swinging gently.
Row 1 column 4: same bear standing holding a honey-yellow bucket by handle at its right side, three-quarter right face.
Row 2 column 1: same bear tending a honey-yellow bucket, leaning gently down and reaching one paw toward bucket rim, bucket immediately beside it.
Row 2 column 2: same bear walking RIGHT carrying honey-yellow bucket in one paw.
Row 2 column 3: same bear seated, whole body visible, reading an open cream-page sage-cover book held on its lap.
Row 2 column 4: matching seated reading pose, one paw turning an obvious page of the same open book.
Row 3 column 1: same bear standing facing RIGHT, holding a small gray pickaxe with timber handle angled down in front.
Row 3 column 2: same bear facing RIGHT, gently lifting the small pickaxe above its shoulder.
Row 3 column 3: same bear standing with a gray workshop wrench held low in one paw, three-quarter right face.
Row 3 column 4: matching bear gently raising that gray wrench to head height.
Keep each entire bear, feet, ears, props intact and inside its own cell. Exactly twelve bears. All twelve separate complete sprites. Actual alpha transparency. No detached motion lines, particles, drops, symbols, lettering, numbers, border, watermark, checkerboard pattern, black background or ground shadows.
